newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde May 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde May 9.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Communist party reproaches Socialist party leader Lionel Jospin with imposing a government programme on them.
-- France Telecom, Deutsche Telekom and U.S.-based AT&T to submit bids for a 60 percent stake in Spain's state-owned broadcasting Retevision on May 12.
-- Staff at British Airway's TAT and Air Liberte start second consecutive month of strike for higher pay, consistency of staff status in the two companies, and less short-term work contracts.
